name: Search Rows
plugin_description: Integrates with Google Sheets to read, search, and write rows from Kizen agentic workflows.
action_description: Finds row(s) whose column_name cell matches match_value, per match_type (equals, not_equals, contains, starts_with, is_empty, is_not_empty). Returns the matching rows keyed by header name, plus their real 1-indexed sheet row numbers.

inputs.name: spreadsheet_id
inputs.label: Spreadsheet ID
inputs.hint: The ID from the sheet's URL: .../spreadsheets/d/{spreadsheet_id}/edit

inputs.name: sheet_name
inputs.label: Sheet Name
inputs.hint: The tab name at the bottom of the spreadsheet, e.g. Sheet1.

inputs.name: column_name
inputs.label: Column Name
inputs.hint: Header name of the column to search.

inputs.name: match_type
inputs.label: Match Type
inputs.hint: How to compare each row's column_name cell against match_value: 'equals' (default, exact match), 'not_equals', 'contains', 'starts_with', 'is_empty', or 'is_not_empty'. Leave blank for 'equals'. is_empty/is_not_empty ignore match_value.

inputs.name: match_value
inputs.label: Match Value
inputs.hint: Value to compare against, per match_type. Required unless match_type is is_empty or is_not_empty.

inputs.name: return_all_matches
inputs.label: Return All Matches
inputs.hint: If true, return every matching row. If false, stop at the first match.

inputs.name: header_row
inputs.label: Header Row
inputs.hint: Which row contains the column headers (1-indexed). Leave blank to default to 1.

inputs.name: header_column
inputs.label: Header Column
inputs.hint: Which column the headers start in (1-indexed). Columns to the left are skipped entirely, e.g. a leading row-label column. Leave blank to default to 1.

outputs.name: matching_rows
outputs.label: Matching Rows
outputs.hint: JSON array string of matching row objects, each keyed by header name.

outputs.name: row_numbers
outputs.label: Row Numbers
outputs.hint: JSON array string of the matching rows' real 1-indexed sheet row numbers (usable directly in Update Row/Cell).
